messages: Ravi S: Quick note from QA: clicking a docs link that targets a glossary entry doesn't focus the content when the right docs panel is closed. Screen reader users just get the page jump, no announcement. Maya T: Repro? I can't hit it locally. Ravi S: Steps: collapse docs panel, open /console/models#quantization from an external link, panel opens but focus lands on the panel toggle. NVDA reads 'button' only. Eve J: That's not great. We intentionally moved away from forcing focus during animations, but we still need an a11y-friendly flow. Two parts: 1) focus management so the term is announced, 2) consistency in terminology between Console and docs. Maya T: On the terminology side I've seen "quantization", "quantized models", and "int8 quant" across places. We should pick a Console-friendly short label and map aliases in the docs. Proposal: Console uses "quantization"; docs accept aliases and show canonical term with a short tooltip. Ravi S: Sounds good. For focus: suggest behavior: when a link with hash is followed and it targets docs-panel content, open panel, wait for panel transitionend, then focus the target element with tabindex=-1 and announce with an aria-live polite region: "Opened docs: glossary 1quantization1" (replace punctuation as needed). Eve J: Slight tweak: avoid generic punctuation in aria-live. Use pattern: "Docs panel opened: glossary entry 'quantization'". Also ensure we restore focus back to the originating element when panel closes (Shift+Tab flow). Maya T: I'll update the lexicon page to include aliases and add a crosslink pattern: quantization. Frontend can detect data-open-doc-panel attribute. Ravi S: Can frontend also expose a small helper util so product can author these links uniformly? Eg window.openDocsAnchor('#glossary-quantization') that handles open->wait->focus->announce. Eve J: Yes, we can add that util and document it in the docs style guide. Also add a single-copy spec: Console term must be short, docs can show expanded phrasing once. I'll put examples. ux-bot: accessibility-reminder: ensure aria-controls points to the panel container and aria-expanded reflects actual state. deploy-bot: build/console-staging passed for branch fix/docs-panel-focus-177210. Maya T: Thanks all. I'll make the copy changes and add alias frontmatter. Ravi/Eve, can you coordinate on the util PR? Ravi S: Yep, will open PR today. Eve J: I'll draft the aria-live string and tests. Maya T: Assigning follow-ups: @Ravi S (frontend util + PR), @Eve J (a11y phrasing + tests), @Maya T (lexicon aliases).
